login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Typography warehouse & sales
login.clientHint: Enter the phone number you gave when ordering
login.tabsHint: Ordered from us? Tap “I'm a customer”
login.askAdminHint: The administrator issues your password. Please contact us and we'll give it to you.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.materialProfitHint: Sales minus what the material cost us (the purchase price of the lot it came from, as of the sale). Profit here is before rent, wages and other costs.

warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.rollHint: Measured in m² and received as sheets or rolls. Stock and price come from intakes — the «Receive» button on the material.
warehouse.wholesaleHint: The wholesale price kicks in automatically once the customer takes at least this many sheets. Leave the wholesale price empty or 0 if there is no wholesale.
warehouse.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? If it has sales, it will be hidden from the catalogue and the history kept.
warehouse.areaFromSize: Sheet area: {{value}} m² — derived from the size, no need to type it
warehouse.sheetAreaHint: Fill in either field — the other is computed from the sheet area ({{area}} sq.m).
warehouse.piecePriceHint: Computed from the per-sq.m price. Type your own number if a whole sheet sells cheaper — recalculation will leave it alone from then on. Zero means whole-sheet sale is unavailable.

pricing.title: Pricing & services
pricing.masterCommissionHint: Master's share of the cutting work cost. Admin-only.
pricing.servicesOnlyHint: Work rates and master %. Material prices live in the “Склад” (Warehouse) section.
pricing.ratePerPm: Cutting rate, som per running m
pricing.ratePerPmHint: This machine's rate. 0 — the material's rate is used, as before the CNC/laser split.

clients.title: Clients
clients.periodHint: Showing clients who ordered in the selected period. “Orders” is for that period; debt is current.
clients.passHint: Tell the client this password. They sign in with their phone number and it. Shown once — after that you can only issue a new one.
clients.reissuePassConfirm: Issue a new password? The old one will stop working.
clients.bulkPayHint: One sum settles the selected orders, oldest first.
clients.bulkPayAmountHint: Leave empty to settle the selected orders in full
clients.noDebtOrders: This client has no orders with debt
clients.backdatedHint: The payment will be recorded with a past date
clients.mergeHint: If one person was entered twice (the phone was typed in a different format), merge the cards: orders, debt, payments and referrals move here and the other card is deleted.
clients.mergeConfirm: The card “{{drop}}” will be deleted and its orders ({{orders}}) will move to “{{keep}}”. This cannot be undone. Continue?

checkout.title: New sale
checkout.tapToAdd: Tap a product on the left to add it to the receipt
checkout.prepayHint: How much you took now. Empty — the whole order becomes debt.
checkout.cutHint: Turn on if the sheet needs cutting to size
checkout.runMetersHint: Leave empty and no cutting work is charged
checkout.cutInfo: A piece is cut on the machine: price = material (area) + cutting work (running metre).
checkout.clientNamePlaceholder: Type a name — we'll find them
checkout.orderDateHint: Today. Set a past date if the order is being entered later.
checkout.orderDateBack: The order will be backdated — reports and stock will use this date.
checkout.changeHint: Stays owed to the client until handed over — visible in Receipts and on the client card.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.payHint: Defaults to the full debt. You can accept a part.
receipts.confirmUnpay: Undo the payment on this receipt? It becomes «Unpaid» and the amount returns as debt.
receipts.editDateHint: Order date — revenue, profit and the stock sheet are all counted by it.
receipts.editItemsHint: Everything is editable: quantity, price, an extra line. Stock, cost and total recalculate themselves. If the whole order is wrong, deleting and re-entering it is simpler.
receipts.deleteConfirm: Delete receipt #{{number}} for {{total}}? Material returns to stock, payments are removed. This cannot be undone.
receipts.deleted: Receipt deleted, material returned to stock
receipts.changeHint: Empty — hand over all of it. Partial is fine: the till may be short of small notes again.
receipts.editItemsChangeHint: The total dropped below the money already taken — {{amount}} som becomes change owed to the client.

supply.title: Supply & inventory
supply.noRollMaterials: No m²-based materials. Create one with the «Sheet / roll» checkbox in the catalogue (Warehouse).
supply.receivedOnHint: Can be back-dated — the lot queues for consumption by its real date.

grid.title: Bulk catalogue entry
grid.hint: One row per material. Tab moves right, Enter moves down. Paste a block from Excel straight into a cell (Ctrl+V) — it spreads across rows and columns. A blank name is built from the fields; sheet area is computed from the size.
grid.name: Name
grid.hasErrors: Not saved: {{count}} rows have errors. Nothing was added — fix them and submit again.

finance.title: Financial report
finance.stockEndHint: End balance is computed automatically from stock value
finance.dailyHint: Rent, utilities and internet are whole-month costs, so they're split evenly across each day here. A day shows red if revenue didn't cover that day's purchases plus its share of these costs.
finance.dailyHoverHint: Hover a bar to see the day
finance.investmentsHint: Equipment and workshop improvements are investments — they don't reduce profit.
finance.referralHint: Fixed amount per referred client. Shown in the client card; not added to expenses automatically.
finance.cogsHint: For cross-checking: purchase cost of material consumed by orders in the period (taken from lots at sale time). Profit uses the Materials block total.
finance.materialsHint: Total = opening stock + purchases + transport − closing stock. Opening stock and purchases are computed by the system — from stock and from intakes; a hand-entered value wins. Material debt is shown for reference and is not in the total.
finance.materialsNeedSetup: Material cost is off for now: closing stock exceeds opening plus purchases. Fill in the balances under Stock → “Monthly stock”, or enter the opening stock by hand.
finance.periodHint: Every figure in the report is for the selected month.
finance.stockTableHint: Opening stock + deliveries − closing stock = sold. Stock on past dates is rolled back from today's stock.
finance.autoOverridden: Entered by hand; the system computed {{value}}
finance.autoPlaceholderHint: Empty means the system's figure is used. Type your own to override.
finance.cuttingVolume: {{pm}} running m cut · {{area}} sq.m of material
finance.cuttingHint: How much material went through each machine. Sq.m — the area of the cut piece, and this is the headline figure: it is about the volume of work. Running metres — the cut length, the sum is built from it (m × rate). These are different quantities and must not be added together. Cutting per material lives in the stock sheet.
finance.cuttingByUserHint: By whoever entered the order. There is no separate 'operator at the machine' field — if you need the actual cutter, it has to be picked at the till on every cut.
finance.allExpensesHint: The whole history in one list: when, on what, and which report line it landed in. Entries are added in the blocks above, by clicking a line.

expenses.subtitle: Cutter, transport, equipment, workshop upgrades and other variable costs.

myOrders.title: My orders
myOrders.howToPay: How do I pay the debt?
myOrders.payStep1: Wait until your order is ready (status “Ready for pickup”).
myOrders.payStep2: Pick up your order at the shop and pay the rest in cash.
myOrders.payNote: Online payment isn't available yet — we settle on pickup.

home.title: Home
home.subtitle: Key figures for the month and quick actions.
home.whatToDo: What do you want to do?
home.receiptsSub: Orders and who owes how much
home.note: Sales are made by an employee (log in as “I'm staff”). Customers check their own orders by phone.

financeGate.title: Section locked
financeGate.prompt: Enter the password to open Finance and Detailed analytics.

fixed.subtitle: Rent, utilities, internet and the rest — dated records.

salary.subtitle: Who was paid, how much and when.

kinds.name: Name
kinds.block: Which block to show it in
kinds.inProfitHint: Clear it for an investment: the cost stays visible in the report but does not reduce profit — like buying equipment.
kinds.builtinHint: Built-in type: name and order can change, the block cannot.
kinds.confirmDelete: Delete this expense type? If it has entries it will be hidden instead, and the entries kept.
kinds.hidden: Type hidden, its entries were kept
kinds.openHint: Open the spending for this type

stockSheet.title: Stock by material
stockSheet.hint: Opening stock carries over from last month's closing automatically — enter it once, in the month you start from. Then: opening + received − sold = closing. Any cell can be corrected by hand.
stockSheet.needMonth: Pick a specific month to enter opening stock.
stockSheet.linkFromFinance: Open the stock sheet by material
stockSheet.manualCell: Entered by hand — overrides the computed value
stockSheet.carriedCell: Carried over from last month's closing
